_NOTE: Corporate introductions through a partner, Singapore: what the partner earns when a business it introduces contracts with NoFilter directly for a machine and its coffee. Read by build_brief.py only for a partner whose file sets "RENTAL": true; every other partner brief is unaffected. First used for Talula Farms, 6 Oct 2026.
STATUS: Structure and the coffee fee set by Alex on 6 Oct 2026: NoFilter contracts the client, the partner earns on kilos of coffee sold AND on machines rented, about SGD 3 a kilo. The machine amounts (10% of the 36-month rental, rounded down to a clean 5), the first-agreement limit on the fees, and both guard floors below were proposed by Claude and are awaiting his confirmation.
_RULE_RATES: No rental rate or coffee price lives in this file. build_brief.py reads the 24 and 36 month rentals and the cost-in per line from Business-docs/RATE-CARD.md (sections 1 and 2), and the direct coffee range (floor, opener, ceiling, 5% and 10%) from _Part2-Master/_presets/SG.json. Both are cross-checked against Tools/NF-Ops/config/rate-card.json, the extract of the live site. A mismatch stops the build.
_RULE_SHARE: Machine: share = 10% of the 36-month rental, rounded DOWN to a clean 5, held at that one figure on either term. Coffee: a flat amount per kilogram supplied, the same whatever price the client chooses.
_RULE_GUARD: Machine: (rental x term - RATE-CARD cost-in - share x term) / (rental x term) must not fall below MIN_NET_PCT_RENTAL on any of the eight lines. Coffee: (price x (1 - conservation rate) - DIRECT_COST_PER_KG - COFFEE_FEE_PER_KG) / price must not fall below MIN_NET_PCT_COFFEE_INTRO at the floor or at the opener.
_NOTE_COFFEE_GUARD: At SGD 3.00 the coffee alone nets 28.4% at the floor (46, 5%) and 29.9% at the opener (51, 10%), both UNDER the 30% rule. Alex was shown this on 6 Oct 2026 and kept both fees; the fee only exists where there is a machine contract, and the account as a whole (machine included) stays above 30%. The build prints the whole-account figure for the example office on every run.
_NOTE_NOT_IN_COST: RATE-CARD cost-in carries no leasing-partner financing cost. If the leasing partner pays NoFilter a discounted sum up front, the true machine margin is lower than the guard reports by that discount.
_NOTE_COFFEE_ONLY: Proposed by Claude 6 Oct 2026 and applied on Alex's 'proceed': a client with its own machine who contracts with NoFilter for coffee alone earns the partner 2.00 a kilo for 24 months. 2.00 is the most that clears the full 30% rule with no machine margin behind it (30.6% at 46, 31.9% at 51); the 24 months is the shorter machine term and is Claude's figure.
_NOTE_DIRECT_COST: Cost per roasted kg for a direct client, as recorded in SG-WHOLESALE.json on 17 Sep 2026 against the costing calculator (6.00 green-kg roast fee). Internal guard input only; it is never printed.
FEE_TERM: the length of the client's first agreement
_NOTE_SUITS: The 'suits' lines are the daily-volume figures from the machine comparison in Marketing/NoFilter-Website/NoFilter-Website-Master.html (read only, never edited). Changed 6 Oct 2026 from team-size wording, because Talula's clients include hotels and restaurants as well as offices.
